title: The Journeyman Hammer
description: Torven's journeyman hammer — fifteen years of work in the grip — was stolen by a Goblin Looter patrol. He tracked them to the dungeon entrance but couldn't go further. He asked you to retrieve it.

stages.description: Locate the hammer in the goblin territory on Dungeon Floor 1.
stages.objective_text: Find Torven's journeyman hammer in the goblin territory (Dungeon Floor 1).

stages.description: Return the hammer to Torven.
stages.objective_text: Return the hammer to Torven at his forge.

title: Dungeon Survey — Floor 1
description: The Adventurers' Guild needs a survey of the dungeon's first floor: creature types, patrol patterns, resource nodes. Standard first-contract work.

stages.description: Document the goblin patrol territory.
stages.objective_text: Engage or observe the goblin patrol (Floor 1, west corridor).

stages.description: Locate and document the crystal chamber.
stages.objective_text: Find and document the crystal chamber resource node.

stages.description: Report findings to the Guild.
stages.objective_text: Report survey results to Sylara at the Adventurers' Guild.

title: The Quiet Thief
description: Mira at the Iron Compass Inn has had small valuables stolen from guests — a coin purse, a ring, a carved bone token. She can't go to the Guard. She needs someone who notices things to find out who it is.

stages.description: Interview guests or observe the inn to gather clues.
stages.objective_text: Find clues about the thief at the Iron Compass Inn.

stages.description: Identify the thief and confront or expose them.
stages.objective_text: Identify who is stealing from short-term guests at the inn.

stages.description: Report the thief to Mira.
stages.objective_text: Report your findings to Mira at the Iron Compass.

title: The Captain's Letter
description: Captain Aldis needs a sealed letter delivered to the Palace District without inspection.

stages.description: Deliver the sealed letter to the Palace District.
stages.objective_text: Deliver the sealed letter to the Palace District without breaking the seal.

title: The Fracture Inquiry
description: The Mages Conclave wants someone to investigate the anomaly deep in the dungeon.

stages.description: Descend to the Crystal Caverns on Dungeon Floor 2.
stages.objective_text: Reach the Crystal Caverns (Dungeon Floor 2).

stages.description: Find and access the System terminal in the Fracture Core.
stages.objective_text: Access the System terminal in the Fracture Core and record the data.

stages.description: Return your findings to the Mages Conclave.
stages.objective_text: Report your findings about the Fracture Core to the Conclave.

title: A Simple Errand
description: No details given. The Shadow Network doesn't explain jobs. You either do them or you don't.

stages.description: Complete the Network's errand. Details are provided in the field.
stages.objective_text: Complete the Network's errand (details provided in-field).

title: The Throne Petition
description: Four trials to prove yourself worthy of political ascension within the Verath Crown's inner circle.

stages.description: Earn the favor of a Verath noble.
stages.objective_text: Earn the favor of a Verath noble.

stages.description: Secure the Iron Vanguard's military endorsement.
stages.objective_text: Secure the Iron Vanguard's military endorsement.

stages.description: Gain the Mages Conclave's approval.
stages.objective_text: Gain the Mages Conclave's approval.

stages.description: File the formal throne petition at the Palace District.
stages.objective_text: File the formal throne petition at the Palace.

title: Break the Machine
description: The System Breakers have a plan. It will change the world. It might end you.

stages.description: Assemble the Breakers cell in the Undermarket.
stages.objective_text: Assemble the System Breakers cell in the Verath Undermarket.

stages.description: Infiltrate the Fracture Core antechamber.
stages.objective_text: Infiltrate the Fracture Core antechamber and observe the wound.

stages.description: Access the System terminal and plant the break signal.
stages.objective_text: Access the System terminal and plant the break signal in the network.

stages.description: Trigger the break from the Core Chamber.
stages.objective_text: Trigger the break sequence from the Core Chamber.
